newsitem.title: USA: Prodigy names two execs for int'l expansion plans.
newsitem.headline: Prodigy names two execs for int'l expansion plans.

text.p: Prodigy Inc, the online service, said that it named two executives to oversee its international expansion plans and technical development.

Prodigy named Paul Tucker to a newly created position of senior vice president and general manager, international. Tucker was previously with Mehta Corp., where he was chief executive of the software company.

Tucker will oversee all international businesses, including its expansion into foreign markets. Prodigy also appointed Inder Gopal to the new position of senior vice president and chief technology officer.
Gopal was previously with International Business Machines Corp, where he held a number of positions, including director of networking and Internet research.
At Prodigy, Gopal will be responsible for all software development and technical strategies for the company.
